prompt_plain: Explain why regular pentagons cannot tessellate the plane by themselves.

prompt_parts.text: Explain why regular pentagons cannot tessellate the plane by themselves.

worked_solution: Interior angle of a regular pentagon: 3(180°)/5 = 108°
Angles at a vertex must add to exactly 360°
3 pentagons: 324° leaves a 36° gap. 4 pentagons: 432° overlaps
360/108 is not a whole number, so the pentagons never fit
final_answer: 108° does not divide 360° (3 pentagons leave a 36° gap, 4 overlap)
